description: Spends prepaid Amazap service credits on a third-party API call, within the account's spend limits. A purchase can't be undone. Only failed calls are re-credited, up to 1,000 sats a day and 500 sats a day per provider. Direct purchases: if you pay a provider's own endpoint or invoice directly, that payment never reaches Amazap. Amazap isn't the seller of that call and can't credit it; the provider's terms apply. Picks the best healthy SKU at or under max_sats and buys it. Nothing is charged when none fits. When Lightning payments are temporarily paused, the tool returns payments_paused and retryAfter and charges nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client key. The same key returns the first result and charges nothing. A call without this key can charge again.

include_skip.description: Set true to allow a listing whose verdict is skip. Otherwise those listings are not picked.

max_sats.description: Highest all-in sats for this buy. A SKU above the per-call limit is skipped. (minimum 1).

params.description: Optional fields for the SKU that is picked. An object, or a JSON array when that SKU body is an array.

query.description: What to buy. The health gate picks the best healthy SKU.

name: buy_best

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Buy best
